zh.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: 它卖的不是 AI 能力，是「你的工作已经在它里面」这件事
zh.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: Notion 自己的说法是四句：记录知识、查找答案、自动处理繁琐工作、专为团队打造。它把文档、数据库、协作和 AI 装在同一套 Block 结构里，定位已从 “all-in-one workspace” 改成 “connected AI workspace”。
zh.USER_PROMISE: 官网原话：「一个工具运行你的公司」；中文页是「一切数据、工具、代理，在 Notion 一步搞定」
zh.CATEGORY: AI 工作空间 / 知识管理
zh.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: 官网现在的说法是 connected AI workspace：把文档、数据库、协作和 AI 连在一起；中文页是从「一体化工作空间」改过来的。
zh.ASSUMPTION_1: 免费账号与付费账号的 AI 额度差异，按定价页而非账号实测推断
zh.ASSUMPTION_2: 中文语料的检索质量未实测，本报告不下结论
zh.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: 两类输入：① 可核实的公开信息（官网、定价页、帮助中心、用户评论）② 一手实测（体验者：燃冰）。未公开的部分允许推断，但一律标 [推断] 并写依据；不写假精度，不把推断说成事实。
zh.STAGE_MATURITY: 成熟期（2015 上线，26 次发布）
zh.USER_SCALE: G2 13,972 条评价 · PH 1.4K 评论 · 19K 关注
zh.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: 官网企业版页面主推安全、权限、合规与数据驻留。
zh.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: 官网小型企业页面主推团队同步：会议记录、目标规划、流程文档。
zh.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: 官网同时设有初创公司折扣页与开发者页（API / CLI / MCP / Agent）。
zh.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: 把散的会议、决策、流程收进一个能查的地方
zh.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: 「我不是不会做事，我是找不到东西」的焦虑出口
zh.JTBD_SOCIAL: 在团队里显得有条理、有系统
zh.TRIGGER_MOMENT: 团队人多到「问同事」变贵的那一刻
zh.FREQUENCY: 记录高频，AI 调用偶发
zh.USAGE_CONTEXT: 日常写作、会议纪要、项目跟踪、跨系统找答案
zh.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: 官网可见的入口：模板生态、初创公司折扣、公开页面分享；其余渠道未披露。
zh.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: 粘进第一篇文档，发现它既比 Word 好看，又能一键变成表格
zh.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: 可以把 Notion 页面以公开链接发布（产品内功能）。
zh.RETENTION_1: 工作内容存在其中，迁移成本高（产品结构决定）
zh.RETENTION_2: 团队协作网络：走得掉一个人，走不掉一个团队
zh.RETENTION_3: 版本历史 / 已验证页面 / 审计日志（帮助中心有文档）
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: 模板库与社区模板公开可见；是否带来新增用户，未披露。
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_NAME: 公开页面 → 外部访问
zh.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: 页面可发布为公开站点；转化数据未披露。
zh.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: 有件事要记下来 / 有个问题要查
zh.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: 写进页面，或把内容塞进数据库变成结构
zh.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: 页面变好看了，数据能一眼看懂了，AI 能直接答了
zh.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: 下次写东西，第一时间想到它；上下文越厚，越想回来
zh.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: 这个循环教用户的是：结构化能换来看得见的好处。所以它真正的产品是「结构」，AI 只是结构的变现出口。
zh.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: 写东西是每天；AI 调用是每周几次
zh.SURFACE_1_ROLE: 空间与页面树，你的结构长什么样都在这儿
zh.SURFACE_2_ROLE: 写作与排版的主战场，块级编辑
zh.SURFACE_3_ROLE: 同一份数据的多视图，是它最强的差异点
zh.SURFACE_4_ROLE: 已升级为主模块，和页面平级
zh.SURFACE_5_ROLE: Slack / Drive / Jira / MCP，把外部上下文拉进来
zh.SURFACE_6_ROLE: 权限、审计、数据驻留，企业采购的入口
zh.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: 内容优先：所有能力都挂在页面这条主线上，连 AI 也是目的地而不是悬浮按钮。
zh.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: `/` 是全部入口——它把数据库所有字段类型做成了命令，这是把「结构化」压进一个符号里。
zh.CRAFT_1_NAME: 块级渲染 + 实时协作
zh.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: 多人同页不打架，这是工程门槛，也是别人抄不动的体感
zh.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: 同一份数据渲染成表、看板、时间线，数据与视图解耦
zh.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: 所有对象一个入口，把学习曲线压进一个符号
zh.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: 默认字号行高稳定，让非设计师也能输出「不难看」的文档
zh.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: 不是弹窗聊天，是答案变成你的 Block——这是它压过纯 Chat 的地方
zh.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: 它所有的手艺都指向一件事：让结构产生得快一点。
zh.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: 写出第一篇的 2 分钟很容易；但要它产生 AI 价值，得先有上下文——断点就在这
zh.DELIGHT_1: 第一次把表格变成看板
zh.DELIGHT_2: AI 把一段会议记录直接改成待办
zh.DELIGHT_3: 分享出去像发一个网站
zh.STRUGGLE_1: 装完不知道从哪开始（实测：燃冰）
zh.STRUGGLE_2: 功能太多，PH 上 17 条抱怨 overwhelming
zh.STRUGGLE_3: AI 额度两三次就触墙（实测：燃冰）
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_NAME: 席位订阅 + credits 加购
zh.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: Free $0 / Plus $10 / Business $20 / Enterprise 定制；Business 每席位每月 1,500 Standard + 500 Select credits
zh.MON_ENTRY_HEADLINE: AI 是升档的理由，不是单独卖的功能
zh.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: Free 和 Plus 只给 AI Trial，正式额度从 $20 的 Business 起——同一批席位做了 100% 提价
zh.FREE_PAID_BOUNDARY_NAME: 边界：写得越多，越需要 AI 查
zh.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: 存信息不要钱，调用和查找触发付费。免费用户只看到两次效果，够心动不够养成
zh.UX_MON_HEADLINE: 对齐的，但第一公里没对齐
zh.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: AI 越有用越愿意升级；但新人正好在还不会用的时候撞额度墙，这里是对不齐的
zh.COMP_INTRO: 以下对比是我的主观判断，不是评分或测量。
zh.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: 上下文密度：你三年的会议纪要和决策链只有它有
zh.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: Glean 抢跨应用搜索；通用 Agent + 连接器直接绕过它的检索层
zh.CHANNEL_2: 官网可见：初创公司折扣页
zh.CHANNEL_3: 官网可见：公开页面分享
zh.HORIZONTAL_1: 官方功能页：日历、邮件、AI 速记
zh.HORIZONTAL_2: 官方功能页：企业搜索（可搜 Slack / Jira）
zh.VERTICAL_1: 帮助中心有文档：SSO、SCIM、审计日志、数据驻留
zh.VERTICAL_2: 帮助中心有文档：团队空间、代理权限与管控
zh.PLATFORM_1: 帮助中心有文档：API 与 Notion CLI
zh.PLATFORM_2: 帮助中心有文档：MCP 接入、代理调度
zh.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: 嵌入式：AI 长在文档、数据库和会议纪要里。官方话术是「代理全天候自主运行工作流程」。已上线能力：Notion Agent、Custom Agents、动态触发器、数据库自动化、代理调度（可调 Claude / Cursor）。
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: 已上线：自定义代理 + 动态触发器（帮助中心有文档）
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_2: 已上线：数据库自动化（无需写代码）
zh.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: 已上线：代理调度，可从 Notion 调 Claude / Cursor
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: （我的判断）把新人引导做成代理：按数据现状推荐路径
zh.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: （我的判断）让代理主动把散落会话整理成结构化知识，用户只审不改
zh.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: （我的判断）AI 越强，用户越可能只在 Notion 存、在别处问；它要么是「问的地方」，要么退化成存储层。
zh.METRICS_INTRO: Notion 不公开这些指标。以下是推断，用来解释它的产品行为，不等于官方事实。
zh.NORTH_STAR_METRIC: 每席位每月 AI credits 消耗 [推断]
zh.NORTH_STAR_WHY: 推断依据：AI 是变动成本，额度按席位发放——这个数同时代表「上下文进来了」和「在付钱」
zh.INPUT_METRIC_1_WHY: 推断依据：连接器决定 AI 能看到多少外部上下文
zh.INPUT_METRIC_2_WHY: 推断依据：收入结构是席位订阅
zh.INPUT_METRIC_3_WHY: 推断依据：决定 AI 是否真进了工作流
zh.GUARDRAIL_WHY: 推断依据：PH 上 24 条 slow performance，是它最不能崩的一条体验
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT: 新用户前 10 分钟 [推断 + 一手观察]
zh.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: 推断依据：实测（燃冰）第 2 次 AI 使用后触墙；评论也集中在「上手难」
zh.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: PH 抱怨 overwhelming 17、learning curve 23；`/` 是入口也是迷宫
zh.FRICTION_2_BODY: 进门前不问你有没有数据、是个人还是团队；帮助文档也不在卡住的地方出现
zh.FRICTION_3_BODY: 两次就断，第一次心动正好撞墙；G2 有用户因 credits 被撤流失到 Obsidian
zh.FRICTION_4_BODY: G2 有实例：guest 链接被自动建号并按全价计费，客服拒绝退款
zh.RISK_INTRO: 只列有公开依据的风险；概率与严重度是我的判断，不做量化。
zh.RISK_1_NAME: 通用 Agent 绕过检索
zh.RISK_1_MIT: 把连接器与权限做深（我的建议）
zh.RISK_2_MIT: 访客默认不建号不收费；退款规则写清（我的建议）
zh.RISK_3_LIK: 实测（燃冰）：2 次 AI 触墙
zh.RISK_3_MIT: 按有无数据分流入场（我的建议）
zh.RISK_4_MIT: 小模型路由 + credits 收紧（我的建议）
zh.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: （我的判断）进来先问「你现在的东西在哪儿」：有数据走导入，没数据给一个十分钟能跑完的场景
zh.OPP_2_DETAIL: （我的判断）把帮助文档嵌到对应界面里，哪里不会就在哪里给那一段
zh.OPP_3_DETAIL: （我的判断）不是「2 次试用」，而是「3 个完整任务」，把价值演示从次数换成结果
zh.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: 把自己定位成公司 AI 的上下文层
zh.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: （我的判断）不是「更好的文档工具」，而是「所有 AI 读你公司数据的地方」
zh.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: （我的判断）代理把散落会话整理成结构化知识，用户只审不改
zh.FINAL_WINS: 上下文天然聚集 + 数据库这种可被 AI 操作的语义结构
zh.FINAL_BREAKS: 自由度和引导失衡：越强的产品，越要求用户先成为产品经理
zh.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: 迁移成本是真护城河；AI 能力不是，12 个月内会被追平
zh.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: 它卖的是「你的工作已经在这」，AI 只是来收租。
zh.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: 可核实：AI 正式额度从 $20 的 Business 档起；抱怨集中在性能、学习曲线、功能过载；AI 准确率只被提到 2 次。我的判断：它把最难的一步「怎么开始」留给了用户。
zh.MOAT_REASONING_ONE_LINE: 迁移成本 8 分，AI 能力 5 分，加权 7
zh.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: AI 是升档理由，不是独立 SKU
zh.TLDR_1_BODY: Free / Plus 只给 Trial，正式额度从 $20 的 Business 起
zh.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: 真护城河是上下文，不是模型
zh.TLDR_2_BODY: 你自己写的三年会议纪要，只有它有
zh.TLDR_3_BODY: 没有差异化引导，新人两次 AI 就触墙
zh.SHOT_1_CAPTION: 记录知识——会议、决策、流程、产品规格
zh.SHOT_2_CAPTION: 查找答案——信息在邮件里还是 Slack 里？直接问 Notion
zh.SHOT_3_CAPTION: 自动处理繁琐工作——代理全天候自主运行工作流程
zh.SHOT_4_CAPTION: 企业搜索——同步搜索 Notion、Slack、Jira
zh.SHOT_5_CAPTION: 专为团队打造——企业级安全、管理员控制、代理管控
zh.SHOT_6_CAPTION: 一个可以对话的代理，直接执行任务

en.ONE_LINER_2_LINE_SUBTITLE: It doesn't sell AI. It sells the fact that your work already lives inside it.
en.SNAPSHOT_ONE_TO_TWO_SENTENCE_DEFINITION: Notion packs docs, databases, collaboration and AI into one Block structure. Its own positioning moved from 'all-in-one workspace' to 'connected AI workspace'.
en.USER_PROMISE: All your work in one place, with AI that can actually act on it
en.CATEGORY_POSITIONING_PARAGRAPH: Only two things matter now: who owns the context, and who makes decisions for the user. Notion has the first by default; the second is what it lacks most.
en.ASSUMPTION_1: AI quota differences between free and paid tiers are read from the pricing page, not from account-level testing
en.ASSUMPTION_2: Chinese-language retrieval quality was not tested; no claim is made here
en.ASSUMPTIONS_ONE_PARAGRAPH_LIST_WHAT_IS_I: Only two inputs are used: verifiable public sources (site, pricing, help center, reviews) and my own hands-on test. Anything unverifiable is omitted, not inferred. Judgement is labelled 'my call'.
en.SEGMENT_1_DETAIL: Needs sync, compliance, audit — the only landing page that leads with security and data residency
en.SEGMENT_2_DETAIL: Wants 'everyone on the same page': meeting notes, goals, process docs
en.SEGMENT_3_DETAIL: Startups get a discount to lock in early; devs get Agent / CLI / API / MCP
en.JTBD_FUNCTIONAL: Collect scattered meetings, decisions and processes somewhere searchable
en.JTBD_EMOTIONAL: Relief from 'I'm not bad at my job, I just can't find anything'
en.JTBD_SOCIAL: Look organized and systematic to the team
en.TRIGGER_MOMENT: The moment asking a colleague becomes more expensive than searching
en.USAGE_CONTEXT: Daily writing, meeting notes, project tracking, cross-app answers
en.ACQUISITION_LOOP_DETAIL: Templates and community (PLG) → teams invite → employees bring their companies
en.AHA_MOMENT_DETAIL: Pasting the first doc and realizing it looks better than Word and can become a table
en.VIRALITY_DETAIL_OR_NONE: Template sharing + public pages (publish a Notion page as a site)
en.RETENTION_1: Switching cost: three years of your context lives here
en.RETENTION_2: Team network: one person can leave, a team cannot
en.RETENTION_3: Verified pages, version history, audit logs as trust assets
en.GROWTH_LOOP_1_DETAIL: Community template found in search → sign up → fill it → become findable again
en.GROWTH_LOOP_2_DETAIL: Publish as a site; readers become sign-ups
en.LOOP_TRIGGER_DETAIL: Something to record, or a question to answer
en.LOOP_ACTION_DETAIL: Write a page, or push content into a database to become structure
en.LOOP_REWARD_DETAIL: The page looks good, data becomes readable, AI can answer directly
en.LOOP_RETURN_DETAIL: Next time you write, it's the first place you think of — the thicker the context, the stronger the pull
en.LOOP_ONE_LINE_INSIGHT_WHAT_THE_LOOP_ACTU: The loop teaches one thing: structure pays off visibly. So the real product is structure; AI is how structure gets monetized.
en.LOOP_FREQ_NOTE_TRIGGER_CONTEXT: Writing daily; AI a few times a week
en.SURFACE_1_ROLE: Spaces and page tree — where your structure lives
en.SURFACE_2_ROLE: Block editing, the main writing surface
en.SURFACE_3_ROLE: Multiple views over one dataset — its strongest differentiator
en.SURFACE_4_ROLE: Promoted to a top-level module, on par with pages
en.SURFACE_5_ROLE: Slack / Drive / Jira / MCP — pulls outside context in
en.SURFACE_6_ROLE: Permissions, audit, residency — the enterprise buying gate
en.IA_LOGIC_PARAGRAPH: Content-first: every capability hangs off the page spine — even AI is a destination, not a floating button.
en.NAV_INTERACTION_PARAGRAPH: `/` is the single entry point: it turns every database field type into a command, compressing structure into one symbol.
en.CRAFT_1_DETAIL: Multiple cursors without conflict — a hard engineering bar others can't fake
en.CRAFT_2_DETAIL: One dataset rendered as table, board or timeline — data decoupled from view
en.CRAFT_3_DETAIL: Every object behind one entry point; learning curve compressed into a symbol
en.CRAFT_4_DETAIL: Stable defaults for size, leading and spacing so non-designers ship 'not ugly' docs
en.CRAFT_5_DETAIL: Not a chat popup: the answer becomes your content — this is what beats pure chat
en.CRAFT_PRINCIPLE: Every craft decision pushes one way: make structure faster to produce.
en.TTV_NOTE_WHAT_HAPPENS_AT_AHA: Writing the first doc takes 2 minutes; getting AI value requires context first — that's the break
en.DELIGHT_1: Watching a table become a board
en.DELIGHT_2: AI turning meeting notes into tasks
en.DELIGHT_3: Sharing a page that looks like a website
en.STRUGGLE_1: After install, no idea where to start (my own test)
en.STRUGGLE_3: AI quota runs out after 2-3 uses
en.REVENUE_MODEL_DETAIL: Free $0 / Plus $10 / Business $20 / Enterprise custom; Business includes 1,500 Standard + 500 Select credits per seat per month
en.MON_ENTRY_HEADLINE: AI is an upsell reason, not a standalone SKU
en.MON_ENTRY_DETAIL: Free and Plus only get an AI trial; real quota starts at $20 Business — a 100% price lift on the same seat
en.FREE_PAID_BOUNDARY_NAME: Boundary: the more you write, the more you need AI to find it
en.FREE_PAID_DETAIL: Storing is free; retrieval and generation trigger payment. Free users see two tastes — enough to want, not enough to build a habit
en.UX_MON_HEADLINE: Aligned, except at the first mile
en.UX_MON_DETAIL_ARE_THEY_ALIGNED_OR_IN_TEN: The more useful AI becomes, the more users upgrade — but newcomers hit the quota wall exactly before they can use it well
en.COMP_INTRO: The comparison below is subjective judgement, not scoring or measurement.
en.COMP_WHERE_OWN_WINS: Context density: three years of meeting notes and decision chains only it has
en.COMP_WHERE_RIVALS_CATCH: Glean owns cross-app search; general agents + connectors can bypass its retrieval layer
en.PLATFORM_2: MCP + agent scheduling, bringing Claude / Cursor in as executors
en.CURRENT_AI_USAGE_PARAGRAPH: Embedded: AI lives inside docs, databases and meeting notes rather than as a standalone entry. Agents can run triggered workflows, but still need human setup.
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_1: Meeting → notes → tasks → archive, fully automated
en.AGENTIC_CANDIDATE_3: Database properties and status transitions auto-filled
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_1: Turn onboarding into an agent: recommend a path based on what data you already have
en.AI_OPPORTUNITY_2: Proactively structure scattered Slack/email into knowledge; users only approve
en.AI_DISRUPTION_RISK: The stronger AI gets, the more users store in Notion but ask elsewhere. It must be the place you ask, or it degrades into storage.
en.METRICS_INTRO: Notion does not publish these metrics. Nothing here is inferred.
en.GUARDRAIL_WHY: Only verifiable fact: 24 'slow performance' complaints on PH
en.METRIC_BLINDSPOT_WHY: No public data; my hands-on observation is a missing first-mile guide
en.FRICTION_1_BODY_WHY_IT_MATTERS: 17 'overwhelming', 23 'learning curve' on PH; `/` is both entry and maze
en.FRICTION_2_BODY: It never asks whether you have data or whether you're solo or a team; docs never appear where you get stuck
en.FRICTION_3_BODY: Two uses and it's gone — the first moment of interest lands exactly on the wall
en.FRICTION_4_BODY: A G2 case: guest links auto-created billed accounts at full price; refunds refused
en.RISK_INTRO: Only risks with public evidence. Severity and likelihood are my call, not quantified.
en.RISK_1_MIT: Make connectors and permissions the moat, not a feature
en.RISK_2_MIT: No auto-account, no auto-charge for guests; make refund rules explicit
en.RISK_3_MIT: Route users by whether they already have data
en.OPP_1_DETAIL_WHAT_HOW_WHY: Ask 'where is your stuff now?': import if you have data, a 10-minute scenario if you don't
en.OPP_2_DETAIL: Embed the exact help section inside the exact screen where users get stuck
en.OPP_3_HEADLINE: Quota by task, not by attempt
en.OPP_3_DETAIL: 'Three complete tasks' instead of 'two trial uses' — demonstrate value as outcome, not as count
en.STRATEGIC_HEADLINE: Become the context layer for company AI
en.STRATEGIC_DETAIL_HIGH_IMPACT_BET: Not 'a better docs tool' but 'where all AI reads your company data' — that defines its relationship with Glean and general agents
en.MOONSHOT_DETAIL_WHY_IT_COULD_RESHAPE_THE: Users only approve: agents turn scattered conversation into structured knowledge, solving the 'I can't build structure' dead end
en.FINAL_WINS: Natural context aggregation + a semantic structure AI can operate on
en.FINAL_BREAKS: Freedom and guidance are unbalanced: the stronger the product, the more it demands the user become a PM
en.FINAL_MOAT_OR_LACK_THEREOF: Switching cost is a real moat; AI capability is not — it will be matched within 12 months
en.VERDICT_ONE_LINER: It sells 'your work already lives here'. AI just collects the rent.
en.VERDICT_BODY_2_3_LINES: Verifiable: real AI quota starts at $20 Business; complaints cluster on performance, learning curve and overload; AI accuracy is mentioned twice. My call: it leaves the hardest step, how to start, to the user.
en.TLDR_1_HEADLINE: AI is an upsell reason, not a SKU
en.TLDR_1_BODY: Free / Plus get a trial only; real quota starts at $20 Business
en.TLDR_2_HEADLINE: The moat is context, not the model
en.TLDR_2_BODY: Three years of your own meeting notes — only it has them
en.TLDR_3_BODY: No differentiated guidance; two AI uses and you're blocked
en.SHOT_1_CAPTION: Capture knowledge — meetings, decisions, processes, specs
en.SHOT_2_CAPTION: Find answers — is it in email or Slack? Just ask Notion
en.SHOT_3_CAPTION: Automate busywork — agents run workflows around the clock
en.SHOT_4_CAPTION: Enterprise Search — Notion, Slack and Jira in one query
en.SHOT_5_CAPTION: Built for teams — security, admin controls, agent governance
en.SHOT_6_CAPTION: An agent you can talk to, that executes
